hud.notes: Permitted with restrictions: the Third Party Tools and Services Policy permits tools that "monitor and display numerical-based statistics in-game" from your own play. Its Reference Guide (last updated 21 Sep 2026, linked from the page) adds: stats only from hands the user played (up to 30 observed hands per session to seed a HUD), raw counts / opportunities, colour by at most two raw thresholds, pop-ups allowed; no stats split by card values, no display that changes with game state (position, stacks) or opponent tendencies, no labels or categories, no hand charts, no graph of more than one data point. Read on pokerstars.uk: pokerstars.com is blocked from Croatia. docs/research/HUD-POLICIES.md.

tiling.notes: Permitted: the Third Party Tools and Services Policy Reference Guide (last updated 21 Sep 2026) lists "Tiles tables based on big blind amount" among permitted utility scripts. A script may not use card values, relative position or any player's action ("Repositions a table if dealt a premium pair" is prohibited), so tiling must never react to the hand in play. pokerstars.uk now redirects to poker.betfair.com (blocked from Croatia); the PDF was read directly. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

rng.notes: Not established: the Reference Guide does not mention a random number generator. It prohibits tools that "randomize the size of bets", randomised decision delays, and any tool that "reduces the requirement of a human to make decisions"; whether an on-screen RNG falls under that is unclear. Ask PokerStars support in writing. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

sites.name: GGPoker

files.source: Observed on a macOS install, 2026-10-13: GGPoker.app (bundle com.nsuslab.ncf.launcher.live.ggpcom, launcher 1.0, game module 1.0.0.480). No hand-history file anywhere in its data folders (~/Library/Application Support/GGPCOM and com.nsuslab.ncf.launcher.live.ggpcom: UI assets, caches and a few-kilobyte settings databases), ~/Library or ~/Documents; its preferences name no hand-history folder. The glob is the file names of the PokerCraft downloads in gg-hh/.
files.notes: Hands are downloaded afterwards from PokerCraft, not written while playing, and saved wherever the user puts the download - so there is no default folder (paths stay empty: a verified negative, macOS). The in-repo files (gg-hh/) are such downloads, named GG<date>-<time> - <table> - <sb> - <bb> - <n>max.txt. The Windows client was not looked at.

hud.notes: Prohibited: the Security & Ecology Policy (version 20260313) lists "solvers, charts, or HUDs" among prohibited tools; only GG's own Smart HUD / PokerCraft. Also no live files and hashed opponents. Its section 7.2 also bars 3rd-party tools that import or convert hand histories - an import question for the owner (docs/research/HUD-POLICIES.md).

tiling.notes: Prohibited: the Security & Ecology Policy (version 20261029) prohibits any external software that "supports, interacts with, augments, or manipulates a client"; general-purpose utilities only if they run completely independently. Moving and resizing the client's windows interacts with it. Secondary sources report GGPoker's ban of 15 Oct 2026 naming Jurojin and Intuitive Tables. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

rng.notes: Prohibited: the same zero-tolerance rule on auxiliary software; section 2 also bans real-time assistance, defined as any external assistance including software and apps. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

sites.notes: Natural8, BestPoker and ClubGG are GG skins with no real sample (docs/unsupported-formats.md); they get entries of their own once a file confirms the grammar.

hud.notes: Permitted: the poker rules (section 1.2, PDF of 10 Oct 2023 linked from the page) list as authorised software that stores your own statistics and analyses opponent data you collected yourself ("profiling"; "Exemples : HoldemManager, PokerTracker, Xeester"). Prohibited: solvers, ICM and equity calculators, dynamic ranges, seating scripts, some dynamic Hand2Note features, data mining / sharing. A tool not on the list needs integrity@winamax.com's prior approval - Rail fits the profiling category, but asking is the safe step. winamax.fr only; .es not read.

tiling.notes: Not permitted without approval: the poker rules (section 1.2, PDF of 10 Oct 2023) list the authorised helper programs (odds and starting hands, trackers, hotkey programs such as WinHotKey) and a program not on that list needs the prior agreement of integrity@winamax.com. A table manager is not a listed category. An e-mail to integrity@winamax.com could make this true. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

rng.notes: Not permitted without approval: an RNG is not on the authorised list of section 1.2, and anything else needs integrity@winamax.com's prior agreement. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

files.source: Observed on a macOS install, 2026-10-13: CoinPoker.app 1.25.0 (bundle com.coinpoker.desktopapprelease; an Electron lobby with a Unity table client). Tables had been played (per-table client logs in ~/Library/Logs/CoinPoker), yet no hand-history file exists in its data folders (~/Library/Application Support/CoinPoker, com.CoinPoker.CoinPoker), ~/Library/Logs/CoinPoker (client diagnostics, no hand header in any of them) or ~/Documents; its preferences name no hand-history folder. The client fetches hand history from its server and shows it in the app.
files.notes: No local hand histories on macOS with the client as installed (a verified negative: no path, no glob). Whether a setting in the client's screens turns on a local export was not looked for; the corpus came from a third party's HUD logs (docs/research/hh-formats/coinpoker.md section 12). The Windows client was not looked at.

hud.notes: Prohibited since 9 Jun 2026: HUDs and statistical overlays (PokerTracker, Hold'em Manager, Hand2Note, DriveHUD) are banned, only CoinPoker's built-in HUD. The page refuses scripted fetches (403); read through a search engine's copy (policy dated 25 Jun 2026). Also no local hand histories (R1.4).

tiling.notes: Permitted: the Terms and Conditions (2026) define Permitted Tools as tools without gameplay assistance that "may include table management software, hotkey tools", subject to the Third-Party Tools & Software Policy. That policy page (https://coinpoker.com/third-party-tools/) answers scripted fetches with 403; secondary reports of it say stacking, tiling and arranging windows is acceptable within reasonable limits. Confidence medium: the owner should read the policy page in a browser. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.

rng.notes: Prohibited: the Terms and Conditions (2026) define Prohibited Software as any tool or overlay giving a direct or indirect gameplay advantage or strategic assistance, naming decision engines and recommendation engines. docs/research/TILING-POLICIES.md.
